## Services

### Pediatric Services
- Newborn & Infant Care: Health checkups, feeding guidance, developmental monitoring for newborns and infants
- Vaccinations & Immunization: Complete programs per national immunization schedule, travel vaccinations
- Common Illness Treatment: Fever, cough, infections, respiratory conditions in children
- Growth & Nutrition Counseling: Regular growth monitoring and personalized nutrition advice
- Allergy & Asthma Care: Evaluation and management of allergies and asthma in children
- School Health Guidance: Health assessments for school readiness

### Orthopedic Services
- Joint Pain Evaluation: Assessment and treatment of arthritis and degenerative joint conditions
- Sports Injury Treatment: Diagnosis and rehabilitation of sprains, strains, and ligament tears
- Fracture Care & Follow-up: Treatment and rehabilitation with physiotherapy guidance
- Back & Neck Pain Management: Conservative treatment including posture correction
- Arthritis Care: Medication, lifestyle modifications, joint preservation
- Post-Operative Care: Follow-up after orthopedic surgeries

## Consultation Fees
- Pediatric consultation: Starting from ₹800
- Orthopedic consultation: Starting from ₹1,000

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Do you accept walk-in appointments?**
Yes, walk-in patients are welcome for urgent consultations. Advance booking recommended for specialized consultations.

**What are consultation fees?**
Pediatric consultations start from ₹800; orthopedic consultations start from ₹1,000.

**Do you provide emergency services?**
Non-emergency care only. For medical emergencies, please call 108 (ambulance) or visit the nearest emergency facility immediately.

**Do you accept health insurance?**
Yes, most major health insurance plans are accepted. Bring your insurance card and ID proof.

**What vaccinations do you provide?**
All routine childhood vaccinations per national immunization schedule, plus travel vaccinations for adults and children.

**How can I book an appointment?**
Call 022 2500 8858, WhatsApp +912225008858, or use the contact form at https://www.swastiknursinghome.org/contact

**Is parking available?**
Yes, dedicated parking is available for patients, with additional street parking nearby.

**What should I bring for a first visit?**
Previous medical records, current medications, insurance information, and ID proof. For pediatric visits, bring the child's vaccination records.

**Do you provide home visits?**
Routine home visits are not available. Special cases with mobility issues may be discussed with the doctor.

**How long are appointments?**
Initial consultations: 15–20 minutes. Follow-up visits: 10–15 minutes. Complex cases may need longer.

## Why Choose Swastik Nursing Home
- Experienced doctors with expertise in pediatrics and orthopedics
- Family-friendly, welcoming atmosphere designed for children and families
- Convenient location at Bhaveshwar Plaza in Ghatkopar West, with parking
- Over 20 years serving the Ghatkopar West community
- Personalized care and customized treatment plans
